_note: Cycle I only: rooms for /cycle-i/in-your-space/. Each plate is a frontal room image (1024x1536). px_per_cm = pixels per centimetre on the wall plane, measured from the furniture (seat ~45 cm, desk ~75 cm). floor_y = where the wall meets the floor (px). centre_x = hanging centre (px); pieces hang centred 147 cm above the floor, raised if they would meet the furniture. box = [left, top, right, bottom] of clear wall (px). Then run: python tools/render_rooms.py
